meanings.note: Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?
We are in a big hurry for the train.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: всё получилось = it all worked out

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.
I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: short forms: благодарен, благодарна, благодарны + dative

examples.trans: I am very grateful to you.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: usually in short form обязан/обязана + dative + instrumental

examples.trans: You are obliged to come on time.
There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: to take a rest or sleep temporarily
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович испытывает к вам чувства.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich has feelings for you.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.
